items.name: conclave
items.title: CONCLAVE ARCANIQUE
items.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one high resolution landscape collector catalog concept sheet for CLUTCH esports prediction app. This is ONE universe and all its proposed figurines. Premium physically plausible painted resin collectible statues with subtle metal details, full-body original gaming designs. Matte dark graphite studio backdrop, soft warm overhead showcase spotlights, neutral fill, excellent detail, each object fully visible with breathing room. Uniform simple round charcoal plinths, consistent scale suitable for individual shelf slots, no huge dioramas, no glass doors obscuring figures, no extra figures, no profile cards. Large header exact universe title, smaller given subtitle, small CLUTCH wordmark. Each figurine has its exact name legibly printed beneath its plinth. No other words, no stats, no prices, no rarity labels, no busy props. High-end collectible photography style, not flat cartoon portraits. Preserve existing figure design descriptions, new figures visually coherent within universe. No existing game franchise logos. Title 'CONCLAVE ARCANIQUE'. Subtitle '4 figurines · Familiers et magie végétale'. Figures: Four figures in a single evenly spaced row: 'BRUMOUSSE' round cream furry plant familiar with huge dark eyes, green leaf crown and purple crystal buds, squat adorable silhouette; 'LUMIFLOR' elegant small fox with petal ears, ivory fur, lilac pink flowers and long curled leaf tail; 'ROCORNE' squat stone guardian with a single blunt crystal horn, moss-covered shoulders and tiny emerald eyes, bulky friendly silhouette; 'MYCÉLUNE' small mushroom wizard with large deep purple mushroom cap, cream stem face, short robe and a hanging warm lantern.
